issue: GDPR mapping marks JWT Authentication as Mandatory and OAuth2 / OpenID Connect as Mandatory; service has openid-connect but is missing jwt
recommendedAction: Enable and configure the jwt plugin on AM_FCA_SF to complement existing openid-connect; configure JWKS, issuer, and claim validations and test authenticated flows.
impact: Unauthenticated requests will be blocked; requires clients to present valid JWTs with minor latency increase.
securityStandardReference: OWASP API Top 10 2023 API2:2023 Broken Authentication; GDPR Article 32 Security of Processing

issue: Service has no plugins enabled, missing mandatory GDPR authentication plugins: JWT Authentication and OAuth2 / OpenID Connect per plugin-to-standard mapping.
recommendedAction: Enable JWT Authentication and OAuth2 / OpenID Connect (openid-connect or oauth2 + jwt) on Healthcheck; define auth scope, exclude liveness probe if needed via anonymous or route split.
impact: Service will require authentication; ensure monitoring/health probes use valid credentials or unauthenticated exception path.
securityStandardReference: NIST 800-53 IA-2 Identification and Authentication; GDPR Article 32 Security of Processing

issue: GDPR requires JWT Authentication and OAuth2/OpenID Connect as Mandatory per mapping; Authentication Policy v1.0 requires jwt, oauth2, key-auth. Service has key-auth, acl, ai-proxy-advanced but lacks jwt and oauth2, so does not satisfy GDPR authentication requirements.
recommendedAction: Enable and configure jwt and oauth2 (or openid-connect) plugins on MyMetaAIGatewayService alongside existing key-auth and acl; migrate clients to OAuth2 token flow with JWT validation.
impact: Stronger user authentication for AI gateway; key-auth clients must migrate to OAuth2/JWT, requires coordination.
securityStandardReference: OWASP API Top 10 2023 API2:2023 Broken Authentication; ISO 27001:2022 A.5.17 Authentication Information

issue: No plugins enabled; GDPR requires secure handling of personal data and both JWT Authentication and OAuth2 / OpenID Connect are listed as Mandatory for GDPR.
recommendedAction: Enable JWT Authentication and OAuth2 / OpenID Connect on new-service-20260525181340158; configure IdP integration, token validation, and access policies before production traffic.
impact: All API access will require valid OAuth2/JWT tokens; prevents unauthenticated access to personal data.
securityStandardReference: GDPR Article 5(1)(f) Integrity and Confidentiality and Article 32; NIST 800-53 AC-3 Access Enforcement

issue: Service enables only ai-mcp-proxy and lacks Mandatory GDPR authentication plugins JWT Authentication and OAuth2 / OpenID Connect required for secure handling of personal data.
recommendedAction: Enable JWT Authentication and OAuth2 / OpenID Connect (openid-connect) on orders-api in front of ai-mcp-proxy; enforce token validation and scopes for order operations.
impact: MCP/AI consumers must authenticate with OAuth2/JWT; blocks anonymous access to order data with minimal functional change.
securityStandardReference: OWASP API Top 10 2023 API1:2023 Broken Object Level Authorization and API2:2023 Broken Authentication; PCI-DSS Req 8.3
